infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Commuter Connect uses your camera once during sign-up to verify that your profile photo is really you. Verification images are deleted after the check completes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Commuter Connect uses your approximate location only while the app is open, to confirm a check-in on a route you declared. It never tracks you in the background.

plugins.cameraPermission: Commuter Connect uses your camera once during sign-up to verify that your profile photo is really you. Verification images are deleted after the check completes.

plugins.photosPermission: Commuter Connect accesses photos you select only to set your profile picture.
